data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Time Zone Converter with two cities, then holidays for a country, then a Sync email to ops, then discard), but it names the Holidays menu path differently ("Calendar > Holidays and observances"). It also lists "Click Discard/Send" where the true workflow says never to send, and it adds redundant parameters (recipient, offset, dates), though the core parameters (city A, city B, country, month) are present, so the spec is buildable once Discard is fixed.
